policy: Use preregistered single-rank shards with the established 55-second wall-clock full-atlas window. If one times out with no result, repeat the identical shard once. Only after two timeouts may a separately preregistered exact sufficient-certificate protocol be used; it does not retroactively complete the full-atlas protocol.
